import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { gpxFileTags } from "../../../backend/schema/gpx_file_tags";

export const gpxFileTagsCms = customizeTable<typeof gpxFileTags>("gpx_file_tags", {
    icon: "Tag",
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    display: {
        title: "tag"
    },
    fields: {
        tag: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["id", "tag", "gpx"]
});
